text: Don't spend a batch's job slots on re-reads that end in 'needs accepting'. A batch with $22 and 4 job slots left just ended with nothing landed: all 4 slots went to old requests (from 10-16 Oct) that were read again after a settings change and came back 'needs accepting' at $0.06-0.18 each. A re-read that only produces 'needs accepting' should not count toward --job-limit, and the batch should go on to the next item. Acceptance: a test where a batch with job limit 1 meets a re-read that needs accepting and then still runs the next item.
